pkgmetadata.longdescription: LDC is a D compiler based on the LLVM infrastructure. This package follows Arch extra/ldc's cmake/ninja build, but uses dev-lang/dmd as the first host compiler instead of a pre-existing ldc (Arch self-hosts). The runtime and Phobos (Arch's liblphobos) are produced by the same cmake build using the just-built ldc2, so they are installed here rather than as a separate package. LLVM 15–21 are supported; the default slot is 21, the newest LDC 1.42 accepts.
